skill.name: executing-plans
skill.description: Guides AI assistants through written implementation plans using critical review, batched execution, verification, and feedback checkpoints.
skill.summary: Executes written implementation plans in batches with review checkpoints and verification.
skill.author: Cycleaddict

security_audit.summary: Static analysis scanned one prompt-only file and found no suspicious patterns. I found no semantic evidence of prompt injection, data exfiltration, unauthorized tool use, or executable code. No remediation is required.

content.value_statement: Long implementation plans are easy to rush or execute without review. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through batched work with verification checkpoints.
actual_capabilities: Reviews a written plan before starting and raises concerns when needed.
Creates a tracked task list before execution when the plan is ready.
Executes the default first three tasks as a controlled batch.
Runs the verification steps specified by the plan.
Reports implemented work and verification output before continuing.
Stops for blockers, unclear instructions, repeated failures, or critical gaps.
limitations: It depends on a clear written plan from the user.
It does not design a full plan from scratch.
It may pause often because review checkpoints are part of the workflow.
The final branch workflow depends on the referenced finishing skill being available.

use_cases.title: Execute a Refactor Plan
use_cases.description: Execute a prepared refactor plan in small batches while checking tests after each batch.

use_cases.title: Manage Planned AI Coding Work
use_cases.description: Keep an AI coding session aligned with an approved implementation plan and periodic review points.

use_cases.title: Review Progress Between Batches
use_cases.description: Require visible progress reports and verification evidence before the next batch starts.

prompt_templates.title: Begin a Prepared Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the executing-plans skill with this plan file. Review it first, raise concerns, then execute the first batch if ready.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for starting work from a ready plan.

prompt_templates.title: Execute a Small Batch
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the executing-plans skill to complete the next three tasks. Run the listed checks and stop if any verification fails.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate prompt for controlled task execution.

prompt_templates.title: Resume After Feedback
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the executing-plans skill to apply this feedback, update the task list, and continue with the next batch.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate prompt for continuing after review.

prompt_templates.title: Manage a Complex Rollout
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the executing-plans skill for this multi-phase plan. Review risks, execute in batches, report evidence, and pause before each phase boundary.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for phased implementation work.

output_examples.input: A user provides a three-task bug fix plan and asks the assistant to execute it.
output_examples.output: The assistant reviews the plan, creates a task list, completes the batch, runs checks, and reports readiness for feedback.

output_examples.input: A plan includes an unclear migration step and missing verification details.
output_examples.output: The assistant stops before editing files, explains the concern, and asks for clarification.

output_examples.input: A user approves the previous batch and asks to continue.
output_examples.output: The assistant applies feedback, starts the next batch, tracks progress, verifies changes, and reports the results.

best_practices: Provide a written plan with clear tasks and expected verification steps.
Review each batch report before asking the assistant to continue.
Keep feedback specific so the next batch can address it directly.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill when no implementation plan exists.
Do not skip verification output between batches.
Do not continue through repeated failures or unclear instructions.

faq.question: Does this skill write the implementation plan?
faq.answer: No. It is designed to execute an existing written plan.

faq.question: How many tasks does it execute first?
faq.answer: The default first batch is three tasks unless the plan or user changes that.

faq.question: When should it stop?
faq.answer: It should stop for blockers, unclear instructions, critical gaps, or repeated verification failures.

faq.question: Does it run tests?
faq.answer: It runs the verification steps specified in the plan.

faq.question: Can it be used with Claude Code and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What happens after all tasks are complete?
faq.answer: The skill directs the assistant to use the referenced finishing workflow for final branch completion.
